title: Creating a work order still works when Customers View is OFF
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Work orders View and Create & Edit ON and Customers View OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Log in and look at the top navigation.
  2. Open Work Orders and click the create-new button.
  3. Open the Customer selector in the new work order form.
  4. Search for or scroll to a customer.
  5. Select the customer.
  6. Fill the rest and save.
custom_expected:
Customers is not in the top navigation.

The customer selector inside the work order form still opens and lists customers (the data is reachable because it is needed to create a work order).

The customer can be selected and the work order saves.
evidence: UI (role WO Create&Edit, no Customers View): Customers is absent from top nav, but the New Work Order modal customer selector still opens and lists all customers (new test, 11 A new Company, A 2 Company, ...) — data reachable.
